settings.heading: Every morning, the mirror says the same thing
settings.body:
The lines on your forehead and between your brows read as tired or upset — even on your best days. The creams promised to help and didn't touch them. And needles? Between the price, the upkeep and the thought of a frozen look, that was never really on the table.

So the lines stay. And every photo, every mirror, every "you look tired" lands a little harder.
settings.kicker: There's a simpler way to wake up to smoother-looking skin.

settings.title: Apply before bed
settings.text: Smooth the patch onto clean, dry skin — from the center outward. It takes about 30 seconds.

settings.title: Sleep
settings.text: The soft silicone holds your skin smooth through the night and seals in your skin's own moisture. No actives — nothing absorbed.

settings.title: Peel and glow
settings.text: Peel it off in the morning to visibly smoother-looking skin. Then just clean and reuse — night after night.

settings.heading: Hold + hydrate, while you sleep
settings.text: While you sleep, your skin folds and loses moisture. The patch does two simple things all night: it holds the skin surface smooth, and it seals in moisture — so lines look softer and "ironed out" by morning.

settings.heading: Honest expectations
settings.body:
Night one: peel the patch off to smoother-looking skin. The effect is strongest in the first hours of the morning.

Every night after: make it your 30-second ritual. Results are visible in the morning and are strongest when you use the patches regularly. Deep-set lines soften less than fine ones — and results vary from person to person.

No needles. Nothing absorbed into your skin. Just a smoother-looking morning, on repeat.
settings.kicker: Look rested. Still look like you.

settings.title: Start clean and dry
settings.text: No serum, oil or moisturizer underneath — the patch grips best on fully dry skin. Oily skin? Pat dry first.

settings.title: Smooth from the center out
settings.text: Place the patch, then smooth it outward so it sits flat with no air pockets. Don't stretch the skin under your eyes.

settings.title: Wear it overnight
settings.text: 6–8 hours is the sweet spot. Side sleeper? Press the edges once more before lights out.

settings.title: Peel, clean, reuse
settings.text: Peel off gently, clean the patch after each use and store it on its backing so it's ready for tonight.

settings.heading: Two minutes to the perfect fit
settings.text: Most "it fell off" stories come down to skincare under the patch. Two minutes of prep fixes that. New to silicone patches? Do a quick patch test first, and stop if your skin feels irritated.

settings.question: Will it stay on all night?
settings.answer: Applied to clean, fully dry skin — no serum or oil underneath — the patch is made to stay in place overnight. Smooth it from the center outward so it sits flat, and press the edges once more if you sleep on your side.

settings.question: How many times can I reuse it?
settings.answer: Many nights with proper care: clean the patch after each use and store it on its backing. How long it lasts depends on your skin prep and care routine.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Just clean it after each application and place it back on its protective backing until tonight.

settings.question: Is it safe under my eyes?
settings.answer: The eye patches are shaped for the delicate under-eye area. Apply without stretching the skin, and stop if you feel irritation. New to silicone patches? Do a quick patch test first.

settings.question: Will it irritate my skin or cause breakouts?
settings.answer: The patches are soft silicone with no actives — nothing is absorbed into your skin. Keep the patch clean between uses. If you're breakout-prone, start with a few nights a week and see how your skin responds.

settings.question: Can I use it with retinol or tretinoin?
settings.answer: Use the patches on your non-retinoid nights, or check with your dermatologist. Never apply a patch over freshly applied actives.

settings.question: How long do results last?
settings.answer: The smoother look is strongest in the morning and fades through the day — that's normal for every patch of this kind. Used regularly, mornings keep starting smoother.

settings.question: Does it work on deep lines?
settings.answer: You'll see smoother-looking softening. Fine lines respond most; deep-set lines soften less. We'd rather tell you that now than surprise you later.

settings.question: Can I wear it during the day?
settings.answer: You can — some people wear them while working from home or relaxing. Overnight (6–8 hours) is simply the easiest habit to keep.

settings.question: Is there a subscription?
settings.answer: No. You buy the patches once and reuse them. No refills, no memberships, nothing recurring.
